title: Implement DPMI INT 31h AX=0102 DOS memory block resize
description: Complete the DPMI DOS-memory lifecycle needed by extender startup. Implement AX=0102 using BX paragraph count and DX live block selector, support shrink, contiguous grow, and truthful insufficient-memory reporting (AX=8/BX largest free paragraphs), update MCBs and descriptor limits, and reject invalid selectors. Add tests for grow/shrink boundaries and preservation of neighboring live allocations.
acceptance: AX=0102 accepts only selectors returned by AX=0100 and uses BX as paragraph size
Shrink returns the tail to the free MCB set and updates the selector limit
Grow succeeds only into an adjacent free block and otherwise returns AX=8 with largest block in BX
Invalid selector returns AX=8022/CF and leaves memory unchanged
Allocation, free, resize and Unicorn descriptor regression tests pass
